name: whichllm-recommendation-core-v2
instr:
# Restore the documented core recommendation behavior

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation for whichllm's core recommendation
subsystem. This scope covers the existing Python modules under `src/whichllm/data/`,
`src/whichllm/engine/`, `src/whichllm/hardware/`, and `src/whichllm/models/`, together
with `src/whichllm/constants.py` and `src/whichllm/utils.py`. Its intended behavior is
defined by the current README, the scoring, hardware, how-it-works, and troubleshooting
guides, and behavioral docstrings and comments in those source files.

Study that documentation and the complete scoped implementation, then restore the
documented behavior while preserving the subsystem's public APIs, signatures, module
layout, and surrounding behavior. Work offline.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
